title: Meridian Credit Policy Section 5.5 - Debt-to-Income (DTI) Ratio
content:
## Section 5.5 - Debt-to-Income (DTI) Ratio
Debt-to-Income ratio is a hard policy control used in credit assessment.

### Core rule
- Maximum allowable DTI: 6.0x
- DTI must be calculated using Meridian's assessed income, not the applicant's unadjusted stated income

### Interpretation
- DTI above 6.0x is outside policy appetite
- DTI above 6.0x is a hard decline threshold
- No policy exception pathway is available for DTI above 6.0x

Where a file also has other risk flags, those may influence routing, but they do not override the hard DTI cap.
